Title: Azure Automation Python 3 runbook support is now available in public preview

Body.Content:
Azure Automation now supports Python 3 cloud & hybrid runbook execution in public preview. The support is available in all the public cloud regions. 

You can import, author, and run Python 3 runbooks in Azure or in a Hybrid Runbook Worker. This includes the ability to upload Python 3 packages to be imported by Python 3 runbooks running in Azure. It also includes scheduling and interacting with other Automation resources, such as variables, connections, and credentials. 

  

 You can learn more about Python 3 runbook execution in the documentation Create a Python runbook & Manage Python 3 packages in Azure Automation
